name: ARAB 1001
title: Elementary Arabic I
description: Beginning Modern Standard Arabic. Emphasis on speaking, listening, reading, and writing skills. Taught in Arabic.
requirement_description: Not open to students with three or more years of Arabic in high school. Students with prior knowledge of Arabic should contact the instructor or the program coordinator prior to registration. Cannot be taken for credit after passing ARAB 1101, 1102, 1103, 1104, 1112, 1113, 1114.
